trans-.definition:
A prefix, signifying over, beyond, through and through, on
   the other side, as in transalpine, beyond the Alps; transform, to form
   through and through, that is, anew, transfigure.
trans-.translation:
pref. 横切, 横过, 转移, 变化
[医] 经, 越, 横过, 齐, 透过, 移; 反(化学)
